## What this does (v2 — sidecar architecture)
Receives Documenso's document.completed webhook, verifies the HMAC,
extracts the lead_id from the proposal_ref, then hands off to the
pandoc-render sidecar POST /onboard which does: Krayin → Won +
Slack #client-success.

Why sidecar: same fragility lesson as workflow 07. n8n just does
the webhook + HMAC verify (Code node, crypto is allowed); all DB /
HTTP side-effects live in the sidecar.

## Deferred (noted in sidecar response)
- Plane delivery project — needs PLANE_API_TOKEN (not configured)
- Templated kickoff email — first clients onboarded personally
Both are Phase E/J follow-ups.

## Trigger
Documenso webhook → https://n8n.underwings.org/webhook/documenso/signed
Event: document.completed. HMAC secret: DOCUMENSO_WEBHOOK_SECRET.

## Test
Simulate with a POST carrying a valid X-Documenso-Signature (HMAC-
SHA256 of the raw body with the secret).
